scope.meaning: Source import, static mechanism coverage, numerical construction and visual acceptance are separate states. No package is declared completely restored by this report.

vectorValueAliasing.otherReview: Vector3Lerp/AddVectorOffset/GetGroundPosition/bound return fresh vectors; AddListItem/ClearList intentionally retain reference-type list semantics. Do not clone ToolRoutine/target objects indiscriminately.

comboComposition.note: Current direct multi-segment basic consumers do not use alpha/sorting; record omission as latent fidelity gap, not an observed visual failure. Lua timeline combo/magazine concatenation still assigns at:time, currently build() tracks use at:0.

staminaAndAmmunition.animationPolicy: Native per-action PlayAnim/RemoveAnim decides whether repeated clips restart. Presence of a module alone does not prove actor animation references or continuity; the representative squirrel source skeleton and 12 contiguous clips were checked.

effectDirectionBranches.nativeEvidence: Oak.EffectDirectionSetter.SetActiveByDirection 0x8865cec; flags 1/2/4/8 select Up/Right/Down/LeftObject. Source branch active flags are not the final runtime selection.

simulationSpace.note: Missing simulationSpace on legacy output is an unverified risk, not proof every boolean must be inverted. Compare native moveWithTransform per emitter; native Local=0 and World=1. Squirrel car/object mismatches were confirmed against the original bundle and reconverted.

easeProgress.note: Static coverage of every current GetEaseProgress source enum; numeric cubic/quintic timing is exercised in one squirrel scene. No all-character rendering sweep.

lessons: Do not label a native package restored merely because import or module construction succeeds; track missing basic/support routes and visual acceptance separately.
Legacy YAML-derived local flags and shader omissions can invalidate a correct action graph. Reconvert actual dependency consumers from the original bundle instead of altering art or offsets.
Vector3 node results have value semantics; snapshot before rotating. ToolRoutine and list references deliberately retain identity.
Composite attacks must retain each child track at, local paths, actor clip bounds and applicable alpha/sorting state. Preserve FX tails beyond actor end.
Discover stamina consumption from the interpreted graph, including graph variables. Weapon MagazineSize alone does not establish cadence, final-shot rules or reload behavior.
A full-magazine preview needs matching actor clips and native repeat policy as well as sequential FX. Do not blindly merge repeated animation names.
Apply source EffectDirectionSetter references before emitter activation; do not render all authored branches or pick an attractive random branch.
GetEaseProgress must use its native EaseType and routine-local time; a linear substitute can hide or delay launches and falls.
remainingLimitations: Static unsupported-node detection is branch-conservative; a listed node may be outside the chosen default action path.
Only six mechanism representative checks and one statically selected mirage construction probe run. This is not an all-hero runtime or visual parity claim.

IsHittable/IsAvailable callback entry contracts are not counted as missing executable nodes; native collision, networking, team rules and battle-wide cooldown/reload state remain outside full combat simulation.
